commands: echo "GITHUB_ACTIONS=${GITHUB_ACTIONS:-unset}"; echo "---branch---"; git branch --show-current; echo "---manifest implement tokens---"; python3 -c "import json;d=json.load(open('lib/capability-profiles.json'));print('manifest_version',d['manifest_version']);print(json.dumps(d['profiles']['implement'],indent=1))" 2>&1 | head -80

printf 'ENV GITHUB_ACTIONS=[%s]\n' "${GITHUB_ACTIONS:-unset}"
echo "=== config.json prflow_implement.allowed_tools ==="
python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('.prflow/config.json'))['prflow_implement']['allowed_tools'])"
echo "=== focused_test refs in coverage-map.json ==="
python3 -c "
import json
d=json.load(open('lib/test/modules/coverage-map.json'))
import re
s=json.dumps(d)
for t in ['coverage_map_guard.py','test_create_issue_context_eval.py','test_module_harness.py','test_python_scr …[per-command-truncated]
gh auth status 2>&1 | head -3; echo "---"; gh repo view --json nameWithOwner -q .nameWithOwner 2>&1 | head

cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow
mkdir -p .prflow/tmp
scripts/parse-acs.py --issue 1078 > .prflow/tmp/acs-1078.md
WP=$(scripts/workpad.py id 1078 2>&1); echo "id_result=[$WP] rc=$?"

for t in test_python_scripts.py test_module_harness.py test_workflow_flight_recorder.py test_workflow_analyzer.py test_verification_baseline.py test_create_issue_context_eval.py coverage_map_guard.py; do
  n=$(grep -rlF "Bash(lib/test/$t:*)" --include=*.md --include=*.json --include=*.yml --include=*.sh --include=*.py . 2>/dev/null | grep -v "\.prflow/vendor" | grep -v "\.git/" | tr '\n' ' ')
  echo "Bash(lib/test/$t:*) -> $n"
done

python3 -m py_compile lib/test/coverage_map_guard.py lib/test/test_coverage_map_guard.py && echo "py_compile OK"
ls .changeset/ | head; echo "=== sample ==="; cat "$(ls .changeset/*.md | grep -v README | head -1)" 2>/dev/null || echo "no changesets pending"

ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)
mkdir -p "$ROOT/.prflow/tmp"
ls "$ROOT"/.prflow/tmp/review/*/*/iter-*.json 2>/dev/null | sort | tee "$ROOT/.prflow/tmp/.phase33-iters-before" | wc -l

ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)
mkdir -p "$ROOT/.prflow/tmp/review"
find "$ROOT/.prflow/tmp/review" -name 'iter-*.json' 2>/dev/null | sort > "$ROOT/.prflow/tmp/.phase33-iters-before" || true
wc -l < "$ROOT/.prflow/tmp/.phase33-iters-before"

cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow; python3 lib/test/test_coverage_map_guard.py > /tmp/t.log 2>&1; echo "coverage_map_guard tests EXIT $?"; tail -3 /tmp/t.log; echo "===capability module==="; lib/test/run-module.sh capability-profiles > /tmp/c.log 2>&1; echo "EXIT $?"; tail -5 /tmp/c.log
lib/test/test_coverage_map_guard.py 2>&1 | tail -8; echo "RC=$?"; echo "---module---"; lib/test/run-module.sh capability-profiles 2>&1 | tail -15; echo "RC=$?"

lib/test/test_coverage_map_guard.py 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "GUARD_RC=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; echo "=====module====="; lib/test/run-module.sh capability-profiles 2>&1 | tail -15; echo "MOD_RC=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"

TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID=$(gh api "repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/1078/comments?per_page=100" --jq 'map(select((.body | contains("/prflow:implement")) and ((.body | test("(pr|dev)flow:workpad")) | not))) | last | .id' 2>/dev/null || true)
echo "trigger comment id: [$TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID]"
if [ -n "$TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID" ] && [ -z "${TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID//[0-9]/}" ]; then
  scripts/react-to-trigger.sh --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --event issue_comment --comment "$TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID" --reaction hooray 2>&1 | tail …[per-command-truncated]
